title: Jonah Goes to Nineveh

questions.question: How many times did the word of the Lord come to Jonah?
questions.explanation: Jonah 3:1 (ESV): "Then the word of the Lord came to Jonah the second time, saying,"

questions.question: What message did Jonah call out to Nineveh?
options: Yet forty days, and Nineveh shall be overthrown!
Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is at hand!
The Lord is angry with you!
questions.correctAnswer: Yet forty days, and Nineveh shall be overthrown!
questions.explanation: Jonah 3:4 (ESV): "Yet forty days, and Nineveh shall be overthrown!"

questions.question: How did the people of Nineveh respond to Jonah's message?
questions.explanation: Jonah 3:5 (ESV): "And the people of Nineveh believed God."

questions.question: What did the people of Nineveh put on as a sign of repentance?
questions.explanation: Jonah 3:5 (ESV): "They called for a fast and put on sackcloth,"

questions.question: When God saw what they did, how they turned from their evil way, what did he do?
questions.explanation: Jonah 3:10 (ESV): "God relented of the disaster that he had said he would do to them, and he did not do it."

questions.question: Who arose from his throne, removed his robe, covered himself with sackcloth, and sat in ashes?
questions.explanation: Jonah 3:6 (ESV): "The word reached the king of Nineveh, and he arose from his throne, removed his robe, covered himself with sackcloth, and sat in ashes."

questions.question: The decree from the king commanded that neither man nor beast, herd nor flock, should do what?
questions.explanation: Jonah 3:7 (ESV): "Let neither man nor beast, herd nor flock, taste anything. Let them not feed or drink water,"

questions.question: Who knows? God may turn and ___ and turn from his fierce anger, so that we may not perish.
questions.explanation: Jonah 3:9 (ESV): "Who knows? God may turn and relent and turn from his fierce anger, so that we may not perish."

questions.question: Nineveh was an exceedingly great city, how many days' journey in breadth?
questions.explanation: Jonah 3:3 (ESV): "Now Nineveh was an exceedingly great city, three days' journey in breadth."

questions.question: Let everyone turn from his evil way and from the ___ that is in his hands.
questions.explanation: Jonah 3:8 (ESV): "Let everyone turn from his evil way and from the violence that is in his hands."

questions.question: Jonah began to go into the city, going how far before crying out his message?
questions.explanation: Jonah 3:4 (ESV): "Jonah began to go into the city, going a day's journey. And he called out,"

questions.question: The people of Nineveh believed God. They called for a fast and put on sackcloth, from the greatest of them to the what?
questions.explanation: Jonah 3:5 (ESV): "from the greatest of them to the least of them."

questions.question: Even the animals were covered with what according to the king's decree?
questions.explanation: Jonah 3:8 (ESV): "but let man and beast be covered with sackcloth,"

questions.question: God saw what they did, how they turned from their evil way.
questions.explanation: Jonah 3:10 (ESV): "When God saw what they did, how they turned from their evil way,"

questions.question: "Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and call out against it the message that I..."?
questions.explanation: Jonah 3:2 (ESV): "and call out against it the message that I tell you."

key_verse_text: When God saw what they did, how they turned from their evil way, God relented of the disaster that he had said he would do to them, and he did not do it.
